Class Animation

java.lang.Object
animations.Animation
public class Animation extends Object
The Animation class manages sequences of images to create sprite animations. It handles loading frames from sprite sheets or individual files, and provides functionality for flipped animations (left/right) and playback control.

  • Constructor Details

    • Animation

      public Animation(String path, int x, int y, int height, int width, int quantity, int dist)
      Constructs an Animation by extracting frames from a single sprite sheet.
      Parameters:
      path - Resource path to the sprite sheet image.
      x - Starting X coordinate on the sprite sheet.
      y - Starting Y coordinate on the sprite sheet.
      height - Height of each frame.
      width - Width of each frame.
      quantity - Number of frames in the animation.
      dist - Distance (padding) between frames on the sprite sheet.

    • Animation

      public Animation(BufferedImage[] frames)
      Constructs an Animation from an existing array of images.
      Parameters:
      frames - Array of BufferedImages to use as animation frames.

    • Animation

      public Animation(String folderPath, String pattern)
      Constructs an Animation by loading individual image files from a folder. Files are expected to follow a numeric pattern (e.g., "walk_1.png", "walk_2.png").
      Parameters:
      folderPath - Path to the directory containing the images.
      pattern - Prefix pattern of the image filenames.

    • getHeight

      public int getHeight()
      Returns:
      The height of the animation frames in pixels.

    • getWidth

      public int getWidth()
      Returns:
      The width of the animation frames in pixels.

    • updateAnimationTick

      public void updateAnimationTick()
      Updates the animation tick counter. If the counter exceeds the animation speed, it advances to the next frame. Resets to the first frame after reaching the end.

    • getAnimationImage

      public BufferedImage getAnimationImage(Direction dir)
      Gets the current frame of the animation based on the given direction.
      Parameters:
      dir - The direction the sprite is facing (RIGHT or LEFT).
      Returns:
      The BufferedImage for the current frame.

    • getAnimationImageAt

      public BufferedImage getAnimationImageAt(int index, Direction dir)
      Gets a specific frame of the animation based on the given index and direction.
      Parameters:
      index - The index of the frame to retrieve.
      dir - The direction the sprite is facing (RIGHT or LEFT).
      Returns:
      The BufferedImage for the specified frame.

    • isAnimationCompleted

      public boolean isAnimationCompleted()
      Checks if the animation has finished at least one full cycle.
      Returns:
      true if the animation has completed, false otherwise.

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the animation to the first frame and clears the completion flag.

    • setIndexToLastFrame

      public void setIndexToLastFrame()
      Sets the current frame index to the last frame of the animation.

    • modifySpeed

      public void modifySpeed(int value)
      Modifies the playback speed of the animation.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to adjust the speed by (positive decreases speed, negative increases it).

    • getSubAnimation

      public Animation getSubAnimation(int fromFrame, int toFrame)
      Creates a new Animation object consisting of a sub-sequence of the current frames.
